blocks.x: Real-time fraud decisioning on instant rails — 38% lower fraud losses at a higher approval rate
A top-10 European retail bank — Banking & Financial Services engagement delivered by a 22-person blended team over 14 months, EU scope, commercial model: outcome-linked build-run.

items: Batch fraud scoring could not sit on instant-payment paths; fraud analysts cleared alerts by volume, not judgment.
Customer, transaction and device data lived in four estates; features rebuilt per model with inconsistent lineage.
Regulators demanded decision-level explanations; the bank could not reconstruct individual authorizations reliably.

blocks.x: We built the streaming decision hub: Kafka/Flink features at event time, champion-challenger models behind policy layers on EEMS Platform, and full decision replay with cryptographic logs. Network analytics across accounts and devices added organized-fraud detection, while the model-risk pack was produced as we built — documentation the regulator read directly.

Delivery followed the standard rhythm — Diagnose with a signed baseline, Prove with falsifiable criteria, Industrialize with staged rollouts — while the control evidence (model cards, decision replay, security tests) accumulated as artifacts of the build.

items: Non-revenue water down 21% — district metering to decision loop
Lead time down 58%, AI margin protected — platform engineering plus AI factory

blocks.x: Towers: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation, Data, Analytics & Lakehouse, Applied AI & Generative AI. Platforms: EEMS Platform, Fleet Management System.

items: the platform configuration patterns and the operator enablement curriculum, refined across engagements of this type.
organizational absorption: adoption paths are designed for each client's operating culture, never assumed.

blocks.x: Client identity withheld under confidentiality. Metrics are reported against the baseline locked in the Diagnose phase; measurement method available under NDA.
